cross_cutting_issues.state_post_S717: Unfixed. Structural alignment needed as pre-requisite for reliable defect scanning.

cross_cutting_issues.affected_items: 2,000 (Packs B/C/D/E all use paired metadata+content objects)
cross_cutting_issues.description: Metadata block stores QuestionID/ChoiceA-D/ExplanationWrongA-D; content block stores Stem/Choices{}/CorrectChoice/ExplanationCorrect. Any tool that reads from wrong block produces false results. DL-020 (validator brace-matcher) and DL-029 (scan false positives) are direct consequences.
cross_cutting_issues.scan_impact: Pack B: CC-before-QID format (unique); Packs C/D: metadata-first; Pack E: content-first (reversed). Each requires different parsing methodology.
